label: Домой
description: A 10-sentence usage card for домой (homeward, to home).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward home. 'Домой' means homeward and modifies 'иду', marking the destination of the movement. It is the directional form, used only with motion, never for being at home.
Strategic focus: Hurrying home. 'Домой' modifies 'бегут' to mark the direction of the run toward home. The adverb answers where to, not where, so it pairs only with verbs of motion.
Strategic focus: Returning home. 'Домой' modifies 'вернёшься' to mark the homeward direction of the return. In this question it works naturally with the future-tense motion verb.
Strategic focus: Being taken home. 'Домой' modifies the imperative 'отвези' to mark the destination of the ride. The directional adverb shows where the driving should lead.
Strategic focus: Time to head home. 'Домой' modifies the infinitive 'идти' to mark the homeward direction. With 'пора' it expresses that it is time to set off home.

missions.phrase: Он быстро поехал домой на машине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Driving home. 'Домой' modifies 'поехал' to mark the destination of the drive. The adverb gives the direction, while 'на машине' names the means of travel.

missions.phrase: Мы пригласили друзей к себе домой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Inviting to one's home. 'Домой' modifies 'пригласили' to mark the friends being invited to the speaker's home. The directional adverb shows the goal of their coming.
Strategic focus: Arriving home. 'Домой' modifies 'прибежала' to mark the cat's homeward arrival. The directional adverb fits this motion verb of coming back.
Strategic focus: Urging to go home. 'Домой' modifies 'пойдём' inside a 'давай' proposal to head home. With 'скорее' the adverb marks an eager, hurried homeward direction.
Strategic focus: Coming back home. 'Домой' modifies 'вернулся' to mark the soldier's homeward return. The directional adverb pairs cleanly with this verb of returning.
